fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) currently trades at 13x net income, but could rise to approximately 18x if guidance is cut 30%, indicating it is not actually undervalued.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company increased supply commitments to $279 billion, with days sales outstanding extending from 45 to 60 days, increasing balance sheet risks.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia has beaten EPS and revenue consensus for six consecutive quarters, with Wall Street still seeing approximately 75% upside potential despite a 21.4% decline over the past month.
